title: Foundations of Faith
description: A comprehensive learning path covering the core pillars and beliefs of Islam, from the testimony of faith to the pilgrimage. This roadmap builds a solid foundation in Islamic worship and creed, suitable for new Muslims and those seeking to strengthen their understanding of the fundamentals. Starting with the five pillars and essential beliefs, learners progress through practical knowledge of daily worship and charitable obligations.

courses.note: Comprehensive overview of the five pillars - essential starting point
Core beliefs and creed to strengthen theological understanding
Detailed knowledge of salah to complement the pillars overview
In-depth study of zakat obligations and calculations
Practical guide for performing the pilgrimage
